note: RNSendSpans models the send-span ring in sdk/rocketnet_allocator.cpp (rn_span_round16, rn_span_place, rn_span_link, rn_span_unlink, rn_region_send_alloc_span, rn_region_send_free, rn_region_send_free_fragment, and the empty-ring reset in rn_region_reset): head, tail, first and last, the list in allocation order, frees in any order, wrap padding, tail == head meaning full, and the reset to 0 when empty; actions Alloc(l, d), Exhaust(l), Free(d) and Reset; invariants TypeOK, LiveSpansDisjoint, SpanInsideRing, Aligned, HeadIsOldestStart, ListInAllocationOrder, EmptyIsZero, FullAdmitsNothing, IdleAdmitsAnyMessage and LiveBetweenHeadAndTail; passing control MCRNSendSpans.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNSendSpansBrokenFloorAtNewest.cfg (LiveSpansDisjoint) and MCRNSendSpansBrokenNoPadding.cfg (SpanInsideRing).

RNServerStats models the running per-slot statistics aggregates in sdk/rocketnet_ack.cpp (rocketnet_ack_stats_sent_slide, rocketnet_ack_stats_recv_slide, rocketnet_ack_stats_sent_insert, rocketnet_ack_stats_sent_remove, rocketnet_ack_stats_sent_ack, rocketnet_ack_stats_recv_insert, rocketnet_ack_stats_recv_remove, and their calls from rocketnet_ack_endpoint_record_sent_classified and rocketnet_ack_endpoint_record_received) against the reference walk of rocketnet_ack_endpoint_update_stats: the older-half window, stepwise slides and jumps, removal of a replaced record, acks in any order, and the received side's time-ordered list; actions Send(s), Slide, Write, Ack(s) and Done; invariants TypeOK, BaseFollowsHighest, CountedIsWindow, BoundsExact, OrderedByTime, PublishedSpanExact and AckedSpanExact; passing controls MCRNServerStats.cfg (sent side) and MCRNServerStatsReceived.cfg (received side) and reversed witnesses MCRNServerStatsBrokenEntering.cfg (CountedIsWindow) and MCRNServerStatsBrokenSeqTimes.cfg (PublishedSpanExact).
